# unifi_access_policy (Resource)

A UniFi Access policy — grants a set of resources (doors / door groups) on an optional schedule. Managed over the private Access API (`/proxy/access/api/v2/access_policy`). The policy's subject/rule graph is controller-managed and not modeled here; this resource manages the policy identity, schedule, enabled state, and resource grants. **Modeled from the reverse-engineered Access API and not yet verified against a live console — see the provider TODO.**



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Access policy display name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is active. Maps to the policy `is_active` config; reconciled from the read view's `active`.
- `resources` (Attributes Set) Resources the policy grants access to. Each entry is a `{type, id}` reference (e.g. `type = "door"` with a door `unique_id`, or `type = "door_group"`). The read view returns a richer resource shape, so this set is sent on write but not reconciled on refresh — HIL-unverified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `schedule_id` (String) Schedule (`unique_id`) that gates when the policy is in effect. The read view does not echo this field, so it is not reconciled on refresh (no drift detection) — HIL-unverified.

### Read-Only

- `creator_name` (String) Name of the policy creator (read-only).
- `description` (String) Policy description (read-only).
- `door_count` (Number) Number of doors granted (read-only).
- `elevator_count` (Number) Number of elevators granted (read-only).
- `group_count` (Number) Number of door groups granted (read-only).
- `id` (String) Access object id (`unique_id`). Import key.
- `user_count` (Number) Number of users the policy applies to (read-only).
- `valid_end_time` (String) Policy validity window end (read-only).
- `valid_start_time` (String) Policy validity window start (read-only).

<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Required:

- `id` (String) Resource `unique_id`.
- `type` (String) Resource type, e.g. `door` or `door_group`.
